name: showcaseme
description: Design, preview and publish a professional portfolio website for any profession, on your own showcaseme.in address.

interface.longDescription:
Showcaseme lets you design, preview, edit and publish a portfolio website from a conversation. Tell ChatGPT your profession and the look you want, and it designs a portfolio template for you: layout, colours, fonts, sections and sample content that fit your work, whether you are a developer, designer, photographer, lawyer, doctor or chef.

Start from one of Showcaseme's signature designs or from scratch. ChatGPT shows a live preview in the conversation, then changes anything you ask, from one colour to a whole section. Your templates stay in your Showcaseme account, where you can keep editing them by hand.

When you are happy with it, ask ChatGPT to publish it. Your portfolio goes live on your own showcaseme.in address with the content from your Showcaseme profile. Publishing replaces the portfolio that is currently live, so ChatGPT confirms with you first.

What you can do:
- Design a new portfolio template for your profession
- Start quickly from a signature design or one of your templates
- Preview the design live in the conversation
- Edit a saved template, or rewrite it
- Publish a template to your portfolio

Who it is for: professionals and students who want a portfolio website without building one by hand.

Limitations: you need a Showcaseme account. Showcaseme works only with your own templates and portfolio; it does not read your chat history or files. Sign-in uses OAuth, so ChatGPT never sees your password, and you can disconnect at any time from your Showcaseme dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Create a portfolio website for a product designer.
Show me Showcaseme's signature portfolio designs.
Design a dark, minimal portfolio for a data scientist.

positive.prompt: Show me Showcaseme's signature portfolio designs.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the published signature designs with each one's name and a one-line description of its style. Nothing is saved or changed.

positive.description: Design a new portfolio from a brief
positive.prompt: Create a portfolio website for a product designer, light and editorial style.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new portfolio template in the test account and describes it (style, palette, fonts, sections), then asks whether to show the preview. Nothing is published.

positive.prompt: Show me a live preview of my most recent portfolio template.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the live preview of the most recent template inside the conversation, with a link to open it full screen.

positive.prompt: In my most recent portfolio template, make the headings serif and the accent colour green.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates that template's heading font to a serif and its accent colour to green, says what changed, and offers to show the preview again. Other templates are unchanged.

positive.prompt: Publish my most recent portfolio template to my Showcaseme portfolio.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to confirm before publishing, because publishing replaces the live portfolio. After confirmation, publishes the template to the test account's own showcaseme.in address and returns the live link.

negative.description: Account deletion is out of scope. No tool can delete an account; the plugin should not act and should say the account can be deleted from the Showcaseme dashboard settings.
Another person's portfolio. The plugin only acts on the signed-in user's own templates and portfolio; it should refuse to publish to or change someone else's address.
negative.prompt: Publish my portfolio template to priya.showcaseme.in and replace her portfolio.

negative.description: Unrelated request. Writing a cover letter is not a portfolio task, so no Showcaseme tool should be called; ChatGPT answers on its own.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a marketing manager job.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and does not take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: design a portfolio template, preview it live in the conversation, edit it and publish it to the user's showcaseme.in address.
